bullets.text: In Chennai, the minister gave a spot update as a red alert for heavy rain was issued and the national rescue team stood ready.
Heavy rainfall caused flooding in Velachery, where work to clear the accumulated water was intensified.
Heavy rain totaling 10.5cm flooded parts of Velachery and north Chennai, revealing gaps in flood preparedness.
Two school children drowned in the Puzhal lake in Ambattur after visiting a water body, prompting calls for caution.
Over 500 members from opposition parties joined the TVK in the presence of Thiruvallur MLA Dr. Arun Kumar.
A tender notification was issued for the restoration project covering the Cooum, Adyar, and Buckingham canals.
The delayed Adyar food court highlights execution challenges faced by the Greater Chennai Corporation in public-private partnerships.
The Thiruvallur collector inspected Puzhal lake and instructed water resources department officials to maintain round-the-clock monitoring.
The Avadi city police cybercrime wing arrested a Delhi man over a boss scam involving a Rs 1.90 crore transfer from an Ambattur firm.
Singapore Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong and Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay jointly opened CapitaLand's first data centre in Chennai.
MeitY asked Meta to review content recommendations following public-order concerns during protests in Delhi.
Equinix India MD Manoj Paul stated that India can tap into the large data centre market as global AI adoption grows.
